quote: 'You shall not supply the Mistral Models, Derivatives, or Outputs in the course of a commercial activity, whether in return for payment or free of charge, in any medium or form, including but not limited to through a hosted or managed service (e.g. SaaS, cloud instances, etc.), or behind a software layer.'

suggested_fix: - 'You shall not supply the Mistral Models or Derivatives in the course of a commercial activity, whether in return for payment or free of charge, in any medium or form, including but not limited to through a hosted or managed service (e.g. SaaS, cloud instances, etc.), or behind a software layer.'(제3.2조) 다만 제4.2조는 'We claim no ownership rights in and to the Outputs.'로 출력물의 소유권을 주장하지 않는다.

quote: 'You shall not supply the Mistral Models, Derivatives, or Outputs in the course of a commercial activity, whether in return for payment or free of charge, in any medium or form, including but not limited to through a hosted or managed service (e.g. SaaS, cloud instances, etc.), or behind a software layer.'
reason: 각주 [^ai-mnpl]의 원문(https://mistral.ai/licenses/MNPL-0.1.md, 2026-08-01 직접 내려받아 대조)의 제3.2조 두 번째 불릿은 'Subject to the foregoing, You shall not supply the Mistral Models or Derivatives in the course of a commercial activity, ...'다. 초안은 (1) 선행 한정구 'Subject to the foregoing,'을 삭제했고 (2) 원문에 없는 'Outputs'를 금지 대상에 추가했다. 같은 라이선스의 정의 조항은 'For the avoidance of doubt, Outputs are not considered as Derivatives under this Agreement'라고 하고 제4.2조는 'We claim no ownership rights in and to the Outputs'라고 하므로, 'Outputs'를 넣은 인용은 원문과 반대 방향의 의미가 된다. 실무상 'MNPL 모델의 출력물을 상업적으로 제공하는 것도 금지'라는 잘못된 판단을 유발한다.
suggested_fix: - 'Subject to the foregoing, You shall not supply the Mistral Models or Derivatives in the course of a commercial activity, whether in return for payment or free of charge, in any medium or form, including but not limited to through a hosted or managed service (e.g. SaaS, cloud instances, etc.), or behind a software layer.' (제3.2조) — 다만 같은 라이선스는 'Outputs are not considered as Derivatives'(정의 조항)와 'We claim no ownership rights in and to the Outputs'(제4.2조)를 함께 두므로, 출력물 자체의 취급은 이 금지 조항과 구분해 판단한다.
